clips.title: The story
paras: A bounty in Lakeshire calls for Lieutenant Fangore's death. Magistrate Solomon seeks hunters to stop the Shadowhide gnolls pressing into the Redridge Mountains. Fangore serves the renegade sorcerer Morganth, and his death would strike at Morganth's forces.

Lakeshire faces growing danger. Stormwind's army is stretched thin, and King Varian Wrynn is mysteriously absent. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon has left frontier settlements like Redridge to defend themselves. The Shadowhide clan raids trade routes, burns farmsteads, and presses against the town's perimeter. Magistrate Solomon posts bounties to draw mercenary blades where royal soldiers will not march.

Lieutenant Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls as Morganth's enforcer. Morganth is a rogue dark wizard hiding in the Redridge hills. Under Fangore, the gnolls coordinate their attacks instead of fighting as scattered scavengers. Their strikes threaten to sever Lakeshire from Elwynn Forest. Fangore's severed paw would give Magistrate Solomon proof that Morganth's brute vanguard has been broken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth. By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead. Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news do you bring before the Court?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, adventurer. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
